mapper.select:
select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.plant_cd from mst_equip e where e.equip_cd = #{equipCd} and e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and e.use_yn = 'Y'
and e.node_id in (with recursive sub(node_id) as ( select #{nodeId}::bigint union all select h.node_id from mst_equip_hier h join sub s on h.parent_id = s.node_id) select node_id from sub)
mapper.insert: insert into cms_collector_seq (comp_cd, terminal_id, last_seq) values (hb_current_comp(), #{terminalId}, #{seq}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select last_seq from cms_collector_seq where terminal_id = #{terminalId} for update
mapper.update: update cms_collector_seq set last_seq = #{seq}, updated_at = now() where terminal_id = #{terminalId}
mapper.select: select state_log_id, state_cat, reason_id, start_at, pack_state from cms_equip_state_log where equip_id = #{equipId} and end_at is null for update
select max(end_at) from cms_equip_state_log where equip_id = #{equipId}
mapper.update: update cms_equip_state_log set end_at = #{endAt} where state_log_id = #{id} and end_at is null
mapper.select: insert into cms_equip_state_log (comp_cd, equip_id, state_cat, reason_id, start_at, wo_id, source, terminal_id, event_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, pack_state) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.equipId}, #{f.stateCat}, #{f.reasonId}, #{f.startAt}, #{f.woId}, 'AUTO', #{f.terminalId}, #{f.eventId}, #{f.occurredAt}, 'AUTO', #{by}, #{f.packState}) returning state_log_id
select wp.wo_proc_id, wp.wo_id, wp.equip_id from prd_wo_proc wp where wp.equip_id = #{equipId} and wp.status = 'RUN' order by wp.updated_at desc, wp.wo_proc_id desc limit 1
select reason_id, state_cat from cms_state_reason where reason_cd = #{reasonCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_conn_log (comp_cd, terminal_id, equip_id, conn, seq_from, seq_to, event_id, occurred_at, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{terminalId}, #{equipId}, #{conn}, #{seqFrom}, #{seqTo}, #{eventId}, #{occurredAt}, #{by})

insert into prd_param_actual (comp_cd, wo_proc_id, wo_param_id, param_cd, value, judge, equip_id, terminal_id, source, work_day, shift_cd, client_req_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) select hb_current_comp(), p.wo_proc_id, p.wo_param_id, p.param_cd, #{value}, case when (p.lsl is null or #{value} >= p.lsl) and (p.usl is null or #{value} <= p.usl) then 'OK' else 'NG' end, #{equipId}, #{terminalId}, 'COLLECTOR', #{workDay}, #{shiftCd}, #{reqId}, #{occurredAt}, 'AUTO', #{by} from prd_wo_param p where p.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and p.param_cd = #{paramCd}
mapper.select: insert into cms_energy_reading (comp_cd, plant_cd, meter_cd, period_start, period_end, qty, unit_cd, reading_src, terminal_id, event_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.meterCd}, #{f.periodStart}, #{f.periodEnd}, #{f.qty}, #{f.unitCd}, 'COLLECTOR', #{f.terminalId}, #{f.eventId}, #{f.occurredAt}, 'AUTO', #{by}) returning reading_id

insert into cms_equip_count (comp_cd, equip_id, metric_cd, qty, terminal_id, event_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.equipId}, #{f.metricCd}, #{f.qty}, #{f.terminalId}, #{f.eventId}, #{f.occurredAt}, 'AUTO', #{by}) returning count_id
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_count (comp_cd, equip_id, metric_cd, qty, terminal_id, event_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) select hb_current_comp(), x.equip_id, x.metric_cd, x.qty, #{terminalId}, x.event_id, x.occurred_at, 'AUTO', #{by} from unnest(#{equipIds,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[]::bigint[], #{metricCds,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[], #{qtys,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[]::numeric[], #{eventIds,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[], #{occurred,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[]::timestamptz[]) with ordinality as x(equip_id, metric_cd, qty, event_id, occurred_at, ord) order by x.ord
insert into cms_equip_inbox (comp_cd, event_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{eventId}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: insert into cms_equip_inbox (comp_cd, event_id) select hb_current_comp(), x.event_id from unnest(#{eventIds,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[]) as x(event_id) on conflict do nothing returning event_id
mapper.delete: delete from cms_equip_inbox where ctid in ( select ctid from cms_equip_inbox where received_at < #{cutoff} order by received_at limit #{limit})
mapper.select: select greatest(coalesce(p.keep_days, k.default_days), k.min_days) from sys_retention_class k left join sys_retention_policy p on p.comp_cd = hb_current_comp() and p.class_cd = k.class_cd where k.class_cd = 'EQUIP_INBOX'
select min(h.from_at) from sys_legal_hold h where h.class_cd = 'EQUIP_INBOX' and h.released_at is null
select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by plant_cd

select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, h.node_cd from mst_equip e left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = e.node_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and e.use_yn = 'Y' order by h.node_cd nulls last, e.equip_cd

select s.state_log_id, s.equip_id, s.state_cat, r.reason_cd, r.reason_nm, r.planned_yn, s.start_at, s.end_at, w.wo_no, s.source, s.pack_state from cms_equip_state_log s join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join cms_state_reason r on r.reason_id = s.reason_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = s.wo_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.start_at < #{to} and (s.end_at is null or s.end_at > #{from}) order by s.equip_id, s.start_at limit 5000

select c.conn_log_id, c.equip_id, e.equip_cd, t.terminal_cd, c.conn, c.seq_from, c.seq_to, c.occurred_at from cms_equip_conn_log c join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = c.terminal_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id where t.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and c.occurred_at >= #{from} and c.occurred_at < #{to} order by c.occurred_at desc, c.conn_log_id desc limit 500
